title: Father and Baby Girl by Trailer, 1950s Snapshot, B&W Photo
description: A mid-1950s black and white candid snapshot featuring a father seated on a metal folding chair next to his 10 1/2-month-old baby girl, identified as Sandy Lee. The setting is outdoors beside a vintage travel trailer camper, complete with its hitch assembly visible in the background, offering a glimpse into mid-century American family leisure and mobile living culture.
